1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that does not harm the viability of the embryos__; (b) obtaining DNA from __the shed cellular material through one or more extraction techniques__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __one or more cell wall degrading enzymes__. 

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature or mature__ embryos.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d), wherein the storage is __performed under conditions that maintain viability__. 

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of genotyping, sequencing, or other molecular techniques__. 

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __results of the molecular analysis__. 

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __for further evaluation__. 

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __performed manually or through automated means__.
